newsitem.title: GREECE: FORMER U.S. DEFENCE SECRETARY WEINBERGER IN ATHENS SEPT 25.
newsitem.headline: FORMER U.S. DEFENCE SECRETARY WEINBERGER IN ATHENS SEPT 25.

text.p: Caspar Weinberger, former U.S. defence secretary in the Reagan administration and currently a board member of Forbes will be in Athens September 25 for a lecture on "Thoughts on U.S. Foreign Policy" organised by the Institute of International Relations.

Weinberger who will be joined by Forbes editor Christopher Forbes will deliver the lecture at the foreign ministry amphitheatre at Akadimias 1 at 1800 local, the Institute of International Relations said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
